title: LeBron in Philly? Eagles' Saquon Barkley pitches James on joining 76ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: LeBron in Philly? Eagles' Saquon Barkley pitches James on joining 76ers
sources.description: LeBron James is set to choose a new NBA team in free agency. Philadelphia star Saquon Barkley thinks the 41-year-old would be a great fit with the 76ers.
